utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, thanks — I’m running a bit late as usual, but could you help sort the donated tools and maybe keep track of who’s bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and keep a simple list of who’s bringing what. Just point me to the boxes and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help out with the repair drive—what’s needed first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. First, could you help me confirm what supplies we already have and what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll check what we already have and list what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got a good handle on the supplies—what do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think we still need tape, a couple screwdrivers, and maybe some extra nails? I might be forgetting something.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape and extra nails covered; I’ll check for the screwdrivers too. If anything else comes to mind, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up. What kind of help do you need?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m mostly worried about the logistics—who’s bringing tools, and where we can store everything safely. If you can help with that, I’d feel a lot better.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help organize the tools and find a safe storage spot. Want me to check with people and make a simple list?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, what’s the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve just heard bits and pieces, so I don’t have a full update yet. I can check around and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that’d help. Let me know what you hear.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re hoping to get a decent turnout this weekend—folks have been pretty generous lately.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m hoping so too — I can lend a few tools if they need them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be really helpful, Gus. I can ask around and see what else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If you want, I can invite a few neighbors myself.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Quinn. If you could let folks know it’s at the community center this Saturday morning, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it—I’ll tell people it’s at the community center this Saturday morning. I’ll start inviting neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re really in for the repair drive, then?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — count me in. Just tell me what needs doing and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and I’d love your help. What should we prioritize first on the block?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the most urgent stuff — broken steps, leaky pipes, and anything unsafe. I can help sort the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be great, Bo — let’s sort the unsafe items first and then we can tackle the rest in order.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll mention the repair drive to folks and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Keep me posted on the plan, and I’ll do my part.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I’m happy to help; just tell me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. If you can bring a hammer, some nails, and a screwdriver, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — hammer, nails, and a screwdriver. I’ll grab them and head over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—who still needs a hand?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can ask around while I’m out running errands and let you know who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Ira—thanks. Just let me know who needs a hand and I’ll help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m in — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll probably be a little late, but I’ll still come by and help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, Dane — come by whenever you can. We’ll keep a spot open for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’m happy to help if you point me to the repair drive organizer.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey — I’ll point you to the organizer and share the details. It should be straightforward once you’ve got their name.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli — just send me their name when you have it, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’m just juggling the school pickup times, so I need to know when the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll check the repair drive time and let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara — that would help a lot. I’m trying to work it around pickup, so I’ll plan once I know the time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive and bring folks together. What do you need me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — please tell folks the repair drive is this Saturday at the community hall, and we’re collecting small appliances and bikes. If they can lend a hand or bring tools, that’d be great too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that it’s this Saturday at the community hall, and that small appliances, bikes, and helpful hands or tools are all welcome.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools over for the repair drive. What do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s kind of you, Gus. I’m mostly worried about how we’ll get everything there and who’s covering the heavier tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can handle hauling the heavier tools, and I’ve got a cart we can use too. Tell me what’s on the list, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive details yet—where’s it happening?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s happening at the community center on Maple, starting Saturday morning. I can send you the exact time and a list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks—please send the exact time and the list of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on — I just want to confirm the time and what we’re bringing before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time works for you, and should I bring tools or just snacks?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated supplies and keep an eye out for any tools we’re still missing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated supplies and make a list of any tools we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m a bit behind on the details. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I’ve been a bit out of the loop too, but I think it’s still happening soon. I should probably check the flyer again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Same here—I only caught that it’s coming up soon. If you see the flyer again, let me know what it says.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm — this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — they’re just lining up the last few details. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — so we’re still good for now?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I really appreciate you keeping an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just remind me what I’m supposed to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Can you bring a screwdriver set and some duct tape?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — screwdriver set and duct tape. I’ll bring those along.
